impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn or_pattern_header(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(Record::GainChangeForTheLaneWithLongName(x))
        | Ok(Record::PanChangeForTheLaneWithLongName(x)) = control.try_pop()
        {
            self.apply_value(x);
        }
    }
}
